reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule/applyWeekendRuleToDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule and RSchedule for the new range handler, and adds shared predicates (isWeekendOrHoliday, skipsWeekendOccurrences) instead of inlining them.

duplication.why: The 'drop daily occurrences on weekend/holiday' step is not owned by the weekend rule but rewritten at each consumer: a findFirst loop in getNextDate, a counting loop in getUpcomingDates, a continue loop in getDatesInRange and an isDropped predicate in schedule-template, and the {skipWeekend, solveMode, frequency, holidays} rule object is rebuilt from config in several places.

placement.why: Date/holiday rules live in shared/schedules.ts and the new handler in server/schedules/app.ts as the tree does, though the skip-vs-move policy is split between the shared module and each server caller.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps; only a small unrelated import reorder in schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: Holiday and frequency handling now leak into four call sites that each must remember to filter skipped occurrences and to pass frequency/holidays consistently (getNextDate builds its rule without frequency for applyWeekendRule), so a future rule change must touch all of them.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange (server/schedules/app.ts) and createScheduleList (budget/schedule-template.ts) filter daily weekend/holiday occurrences themselves instead of the weekend rule deciding it; applyWeekendRule just returns the date unchanged for those.

disguised_duplication.where: The skip-occurrence filter appears reshaped at each site: findFirst closure in getNextDate, for-loop with count/break in getUpcomingDates, for-loop with continue in getDatesInRange, isDropped predicate in schedule-template.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays and getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; applyWeekendRule and applyWeekendRuleToDay gain a '&& !skipsWeekendOccurrences(rule)' special case for daily schedules; getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template implement the skip themselves with isWeekendOrHoliday.
